---
title: "Methodology"
execute:
  echo: false
---

In this analysis, I define a binary outcome for orbital eccentricity and use a small set of stellar and system-level features to prepare a simple classification task. The goal is to build a clean training and testing split so the model can later be fit and evaluated on whether a planet is more likely to be in an eccentric versus circular orbit.

This logistic regression model was fit on the training set to estimate how the selected stellar and system features relate to the probability that a planet is eccentric. The coefficients and p-values show which predictors appear most associated with the outcome, while the odds ratios quantify the weight/effect each covariate has on the probability of an orbit being eccentric.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)

if ("janitor" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
  library(janitor)
}

raw_data <- read_csv(
  "PSCompPars_2026.07.29_10.50.24.csv",
  skip = 328,
  col_types = cols(sy_icmagerr2 = col_double()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

if ("janitor" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
  raw_data <- clean_names(raw_data)
}

df_clean <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    is_eccentric = as.integer(pl_orbeccen >= 0.1)
  ) %>%
  select(
    is_eccentric,
    st_met,
    st_mass,
    st_teff,
    st_logg,
    sy_pnum
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)

if ("rsample" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
  library(rsample)

  split_obj <- initial_split(df_clean, prop = 0.8, strata = is_eccentric)
  train_data <- training(split_obj)
  test_data <- testing(split_obj)
} else {
  train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df_clean)), size = floor(0.8 * nrow(df_clean)))
  train_data <- df_clean[train_idx, ]
  test_data <- df_clean[-train_idx, ]
}

cat("Training rows:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
cat("Testing rows:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
cat("Training class breakdown:\n")
print(table(train_data$is_eccentric))
cat("Testing class breakdown:\n")
print(table(test_data$is_eccentric))

logit_model <- glm(
  is_eccentric ~ st_met + st_mass + st_teff + st_logg + sy_pnum,
  data = train_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

cat("\nLogistic regression model summary:\n")
print(summary(logit_model))

or_table <- exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(logit_model),
  confint(logit_model)
))

cat("\nOdds ratios with 95% confidence intervals:\n")
print(or_table)
```
